text_block_list.text:
Morning.
At the station near Tracen Academy—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Every single morning, an insane number of people get off—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
A bunch of older guys dressed in suits
and wearing sharply tightened ties...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"I used to look down on people, thinking,
'What a boring life they lead.' But—"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Damn.
You guys are seriously incredible—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Trainer, those older guys commuting to work every day are really amazing, aren't they...
choice_data_list: What's up all of a sudden?
What's gotten into you all of a sudden?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: "Because every morning, you go to the same place and do the same work, right?"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Like, tough folks can just,
tough that kind of thing out, right?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Even if it's doing the same thing over again,
if it's 'to win' or 'for someone else's sake'...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Still, I just can't do that!
No matter what, I end up seeking thrills.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I get captivated by flashy things so easily,
and just wanna head right towards 'em.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
That's just how I am at my core.
Guess I take after my dad in that regard...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it—
it's always been that way, hasn't it?
The two of us reminisced about what once made Vodka's eyes sparkle...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
The Derby... The once-in-a-lifetime, no-holds-barred battle.
Man, it was so hyped back then!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Those quarter-mile drag races I saw during summer camp... Man, those guys betting it all on a single moment in the summer were so damn cool.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Fleeting sparks of brilliance like that always end up stealing my heart.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Is it 'cause I'm acting like a kid?
Do I gotta start changin' soon?"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Otherwise... I won't be able to move forward from here, will I?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Pops never changed. So he might not be flashy,
but he still lives his life looking cool.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"If getting to the top means lowering my own flag,
then I'll—!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"What am I supposed to do?
Do you really have to be an adult to compete in the Senior Class?"
Vodka is once again caught in a dilemma between coolness and strength...
True, the higher the stage you compete on, the harder it becomes to stick to your own style.
Even so—
choice_data_list: My roots—they can't be changed, you know

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Huh, Trainer.
What do you mean, 'it can't be changed'...?
choice_data_list: Because Vodka is still just Vodka.

text_block_list.text:
"As we grow, there are things that can change,
and things that cannot. And—"

Her attraction to coolness is something that can't be changed.
Because that is the core of Vodka's being, and the source of her strength.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"The source of strength... Being drawn to that dazzling brilliance
is my kind of strength..."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Then, Trainer,
this... isn't a weakness, right?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
So there's a way to see this through to the end, right?
It's okay for me to keep going like this, right!?

I tell her firmly: Vodka has to win
Vodka's way.

"Unless she does that, Vodka won't ever be satisfied.
She wouldn't even call it living."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
You're right, partner... I'm really glad
I have you by my side.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Whenever I yearn for the royal road, she always laughs it off
and drags me right back off the rails.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
You're right, I am who I am!
All I can do is go with what I feel.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
To beat those amazing old geezers,
I've got no choice but to master doing things my own way even more.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: To be honest, I can't quite picture what being cool next looks like yet. But—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna go all the way!
Like a true outlaw!

That fiery glare from around her debut
finally returns to Vodka's eyes.

It seems the next blade to strike into the street
has finally come into view.
